task: Prove the visible CORE_UNREACHABLE UI end-to-end on the rebuilt artifact
defect: A chat turn taken while KAI Core was down lost its honest failure message: chat.ts wrote it into State.noteMessage (the slot the Core link owns, rewrites on every connection change and clears on reconnect), so the note view ended up blank — the empty card an earlier probe saw.
fix: New State.turnError (KAI's own failed-turn message, survives reconnect); chat.ts catch sets turnError and clears it on a new submit; views.ts buildNote renders State.turnError ?? State.noteMessage ?? ''; island.ts raises alert('note') on the turnOutcome==='error' edge and setView clears turnError when leaving the note; __kaiProbe exposes turnError.
